name: The Darkmoon Faire
summary: You carry a Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival. The voucher is meant for him.

sections.title: A Voucher for Gelvas
sections.body: Gelvas Grimgate is inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival, and you carry a Free Ticket Voucher for him. The voucher awaits delivery.
